title: Manager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) & Internal Controls Oversight
category: Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, Telecommunication, Business Administration, Risk Management
description:
Role Summary
To lead the establishment, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework across e& Afghanistan by providing independent risk oversight, challenge, monitoring, reporting, and advisory support to promote effective management of risks within the approved risk appetite. The role serves as a second-line risk oversight function, promoting a strong risk culture and informed decision-making. In addition, the role provides independent oversight of the Internal Controls Framework and coordinates and monitors risk-based control review, testing, and remediation activities in alignment with e& Group requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, evaluation, monitoring, and reporting activities covering strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, technology, business continuity, and reputational risks.
• Facilitate periodic risk assessments and Risk C Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) across business functions to identify emerging risks, assess control effectiveness, and evaluate residual risk exposure.
• Maintain the Enterprise Risk Register, ensuring significant risks are appropriately documented, assessed, assigned to risk owners, and supported by mitigation plans.
• Develop, maintain, and monitor risk appetite statements, risk tolerance thresholds, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Key Control Indicators (KCIs), and escalate significant breaches and exposures to management.
• Facilitate and oversee the documentation and periodic review of risks, controls, control ownership, testing procedures, and remediation plans for critical business processes.
• Coordinate and oversee the annual Internal Controls Review and Testing Program to assess the design adequacy and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Identify control deficiencies, process weaknesses, and governance gaps through risk and control assessments, and provide independent recommendations to management to strengthen the effectiveness of the control environment.
• Monitor and report the implementation status of risk mitigation actions, control remediation plans, and risk-related recommendations arising from Internal Audit, External Audit, regulatory reviews, and management assessments.
• Prepare and present periodic risk and internal control reports to the VP Risk C Assurance, Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC), and the Audit C Risk Management Committee (ARMC), highlighting key risk exposures, emerging risks, control weaknesses, trends, and mitigation progress.
• Collaborate with Internal Audit, Compliance, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Information Security, Finance, Technology, Human Resources, and business functions to enhance enterprise-wide risk and control management practices.
• Act as Secretary to the Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC) chaired by the CEO by coordinating meetings, preparing agendas and risk reports, recording minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating timely closure of agreed actions.
• Assess and monitor regulatory and compliance risks and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to support adherence to telecommunications regulations, license obligations, corporate policies, and applicable laws.
• Provide independent oversight of Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Disaster Recovery (DR) testing exercises and monitor implementation of agreed improvement actions.
• Evaluate cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, technology, and network resilience risks in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and ensure such risks are appropriately reflected in the Enterprise Risk Register.
• Provide risk advisory support for strategic initiatives, major projects, investments, new products, digital transformation programs, outsourcing arrangements, and other significant business decisions.
• Promote a strong risk-aware and control-conscious culture through communication, training, awareness initiatives, and stakeholder engagement activities.
• Monitor industry trends, emerging risks, geopolitical developments, regulatory changes, and market conditions that may impact eC Afghanistan's objectives and operations.

Job Requirements
Educational Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Telecommunications and Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Preferred:
• Master’s degree in risk management
• Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP)
• Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA)
• Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
• Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management Certification
Experience Requirements:
• Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Controls, Compliance, Governance, Risk Advisory, or related disciplines.
• Substantial hands-on experience in Enterprise Risk Management is essential. Experience in Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Compliance, Governance, or Assurance may be considered as complementary experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in a managerial or leadership role - preferred.
• Experience within telecommunications, technology, financial services, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
• Demonstrated experience in implementing and maintaining Enterprise Risk Management and Internal Control Frameworks.
• Experience in facilitating senior management and Board-level committees and preparing executive and Board reports.
• Strong understanding of risk management frameworks, internal controls, governance, regulatory compliance, business continuity, and operational resilience.
Technical Competencies:
• Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
• Internal Control Frameworks (COSO)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management
• Governance, Risk C Compliance (GRC)
• Risk Assessment and Analysis
• Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)
• Internal Controls Testing and Evaluation
• Regulatory Compliance Management
• Operational Risk Management
• Cybersecurity and Technology Risk Management
• Data Analytics and Risk Reporting
• KRI and KCI Development
Behavioral Competencies:
• Strategic Thinking
• Leadership and Stakeholder Management
• Analytical and Critical Thinking
• Decision Making and Problem Solving
• Communication and Presentation Skills
• Influencing and Negotiation Skills
• Planning and Organizing
• Collaboration and Teamwork
• Change Management
• Business Acumen
• Integrity and Professional Ethics
• Results Orientation
• Resilience and Adaptability

description:

Sayas Group is a structure of companies that do business in several countries from Middle East to Southeast and Central Asia. Sayas Group is a leading business group in Afghanistan. The individual companies operate in different sectors from railway design, construction and management to investment, consulting, technical services, logistics, software development, mining mapping and exploration, and last, but not the least, fuel inspection and testing. In addition, the Group has successfully delivered large-scale infrastructure projects, including the construction and installation of modern scanners at the country’s border points, aimed at strengthening customs operations, trade facilitation, and security.
We leverage our knowledge and creativity to best meet the needs of each client. Our expertise and strong network of strategic partners are the very heart of our success. Our management team, our knowledge of the context, local and global procurement networks, and design experts have enabled us to define the optimal solutions and planning that ensure a flawless project delivery.
We are committed to running our business successfully and efficiently, providing long-term benefits to our employees and stakeholders, and enriching the lives of those whom we serve by fulfilling our responsibilities to the best of our ability. We expect excellence from all processes, whether related to policy formation and program development or project implementation and customer services.
As we continue to grow and expand our reach, we remain grounded in the core values of integrity, innovation, and impact. We believe in building sustainable partnerships and investing in human capital to create lasting change. Our forward-looking approach enables us to anticipate market trends, embrace new technologies, and adapt to emerging challenges, all while staying true to our commitment to deliver quality and value in every endeavor we undertake.

Job Descriptions
The Mining Engineer is responsible for overseeing and managing the technical and operational aspects of the iron ore mining project. The incumbent will work closely with the Mining Project Manager and Mining Department to plan, supervise, and control mining operations, including exploration, geological assessments, mine planning, extraction, crushing, processing, and production.
The Mining Engineer will ensure the safe, efficient, and cost-effective extraction of iron ore while complying with applicable mining laws, environmental requirements, safety standards, and company policies. The role also includes equipment coordination, production monitoring, technical reporting, workforce support, and collaboration with relevant government authorities and project stakeholders.
Key Tasks & Responsibilities
Iron Ore Exploration and Geological Assessment
Collaborate with the Mining and Geology Departments on iron ore exploration activities.
Assist in conducting geological surveys, mapping, sampling, and mineral resource assessments.
Support the preparation of exploration reports and geological data.
Assist in estimating iron ore reserves and evaluating the economic potential of the mine.
Support feasibility studies related to iron ore extraction and processing.
Coordinate with geologists to identify ore bodies, assess ore quality, and support mine development planning.
Maintain and organize geological and technical records related to mining activities.
Mine Planning and Iron Ore Extraction
Prepare and organize short-term and long-term mine plans for iron ore extraction.
Develop extraction plans considering production targets, ore quality, equipment, and available resources.
Manage, supervise, and evaluate mining and extraction operations.
Monitor drilling, blasting, excavation, loading, hauling, and ore stockpiling activities, where applicable.
Ensure the proper separation of iron ore, waste rock, and overburden.
Monitor production volumes, ore recovery, dilution, and operational efficiency.
Coordinate with equipment and maintenance teams to ensure the availability of mining machinery.
Identify operational challenges and recommend appropriate technical solutions.
Ensure mining activities are conducted according to approved plans and technical standards.
Iron Ore Processing and Production
Coordinate with the Project Manager and Processing Department in establishing and operating iron ore processing facilities.
Assist in planning and supervising crushing, screening, beneficiation, and other applicable processing activities.
Monitor the quality and quantity of processed iron ore.
Coordinate with laboratory and quality control teams to ensure compliance with required product specifications.
Monitor processing efficiency, material recovery, and production losses.
Prepare production plans and reports covering extraction, processing, and finished products.
Support the optimization of processing operations to improve productivity and reduce operational costs.
Coordinate with logistics and marketing teams regarding product storage, transportation, and delivery requirements.
Health, Safety, Environment, and Social Affairs
Establish and support the implementation of mine-site health and safety procedures.
Assist in establishing a Health and Safety Committee and monitor its activities.
Ensure compliance with approved safety procedures for mining, drilling, blasting, machinery, and material transportation.
Identify workplace hazards and recommend appropriate preventive measures.
Support safety training, emergency preparedness, and incident reporting.
Assist in preparing environmental management plans and monitoring environmental impacts.
Support obtaining and maintaining required environmental permits and approvals from the National Environmental Protection Agency.
Monitor dust, noise, waste management, water usage, and other environmental risks associated with mining operations.
Support mine rehabilitation and land restoration activities in accordance with approved plans.
Coordinate with relevant departments to implement the company's social responsibilities.
Assist in resolving community concerns and local disputes in coordination with management.
Mining Equipment and Operational Resources
Assist in identifying and procuring machinery and equipment required for mining operations.
Coordinate with maintenance teams to monitor equipment availability and operational performance.
Support the preparation of equipment utilization and maintenance plans.
Monitor fuel consumption, equipment productivity, and operational costs.
Assist in identifying manpower requirements for mining and processing operations.
Coordinate with HR and relevant departments regarding recruitment and workforce planning.
Ensure the proper utilization of technical equipment, tools, and operational resources.
Project Management and Administration
Assist in preparing and reviewing feasibility studies covering project costs, profitability, schedules, and resources.
Support the preparation of budgets for mining equipment, processing plants, and technical operations.
Prepare regular production, operational, and project progress reports.
Monitor and evaluate mining activities to ensure compliance with approved plans and production targets.
Track operational costs and identify opportunities for improved efficiency.
Ensure mining activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, mining procedures, and approved mining licenses.
Coordinate with the Ministry of Mines and Petroleum, relevant government departments, contractors, and project stakeholders.
Assist in managing subcontractor agreements related to mining and processing operations.
Coordinate with the Mining Department and Project Manager on technical and operational matters.
Perform other duties assigned by the supervisor to support project and company objectives.
Reporting Line
Reports to: Project Manager / Mining Program Manager

Job Requirements
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, or a related field is required. A Master's degree is preferred.
Minimum of three (3) years of relevant field experience in mining operations, preferably in iron ore mining and processing.
Practical knowledge of open-pit mining operations, mine planning, and mineral extraction.
Knowledge of iron ore processing, including crushing, screening, and beneficiation, where applicable.
Familiarity with geological surveys, mineral resource estimation, and ore quality assessment.
Knowledge of mining equipment, production monitoring, and operational planning.

Familiarity with GIS, AutoCAD, mine planning software, or other relevant technical software.
Strong technical report writing and data analysis skills.
Full proficiency in Dari and Pashto, with a working knowledge of English.

Job Summary
. Purpose of the Position
The Field & Research Data Collection Coordinator will support the planning, coordination, supervision, and implementation of quantitative and qualitative research activities.
The position will work closely with the Technical Director, project managers, researchers, consultants, supervisors, enumerators, and data management staff to ensure that field activities are completed according to agreed methodologies, timelines, ethical standards, and data quality requirements.
3. Key Responsibilities
3.1 Field Coordination and Team Supervision
· Coordinate day-to-day field research and data collection activities.
· Develop fieldwork plans, data collection schedules, and team deployment arrangements.
· Coordinate and supervise enumerators, field supervisors, facilitators, and other field personnel.
· Support recruitment, shortlisting, training, briefing, and debriefing of field teams when required.
· Assign daily workloads and geographic coverage to data collection teams.
· Ensure field teams understand project objectives, questionnaires, sampling requirements, and field procedures.
· Monitor field progress against agreed targets and timelines.
· Review team performance and provide regular feedback and guidance.
· Coordinate with local stakeholders, respondents, communities, and relevant institutions when required.
· Identify operational challenges and report them promptly to the Technical Director or project management team.
· Support field logistics, including travel, communication, equipment, and required documentation.
· Provide regular progress updates on field activities.
3.2 Research and Data Collection
· Support implementation of quantitative and qualitative research activities.
· Support proper application of sampling and respondent selection procedures.
· Coordinate and supervise structured surveys, KIIs, FGDs, and phone-based surveys.
· Support CATI and other remote data collection approaches when required.
· Conduct or supervise pilot testing of questionnaires and research tools.
· Identify issues in questionnaires, skip patterns, wording, or field procedures and recommend improvements.
· Ensure questionnaires are administered consistently across locations and respondents.
· Support preparation and management of interview notes, observation records, transcripts, and qualitative documentation.
· Ensure informed consent, confidentiality, and privacy requirements are followed throughout data collection.
3.3 Digital Data Collection Systems
The candidate should have practical experience with SurveyCTO and KoboToolbox and should be able to:
· Use SurveyCTO Collect, KoboCollect, and web-based data collection forms.
· Monitor field submissions and progress.
· Review submitted records for completeness and quality.
· Download and organize datasets.
· Support enumerators with synchronization, submission, and basic technical issues.
· Understand skip logic, validation rules, required questions, constraints, and basic calculations.
· Support phone-based or CATI survey implementation where applicable.
Experience with ODK, CommCare, or similar platforms will be considered an advantage.
3.4 Data Management, Quality Assurance and Cleaning
· Download, organize, maintain, and archive research datasets.
· Conduct routine data quality checks during and after data collection.
· Identify missing values, duplicate records, outliers, incorrect codes, and inconsistent responses.
· Communicate data quality issues to field teams and follow up on required corrections.
· Conduct or coordinate spot checks and back-checks where necessary.
· Maintain proper file naming, dataset version control, respondent IDs, and project documentation.
· Support merging and consolidation of datasets.
· Ensure confidential and personally identifiable information is handled securely.
· Clean datasets using Microsoft Excel or other available tools.
· Prepare complete and verified datasets for analysis and reporting.
3.5 Data Analysis and Visualization
· Conduct basic descriptive analysis of survey data.
· Prepare frequencies, percentages, averages, cross-tabulations, and summary tables.
· Compare findings across provinces, districts, demographic groups, or other relevant categories.
· Support organization and basic coding of qualitative information from KIIs and FGDs.
· Prepare charts, graphs, tables, and visual summaries.
· Support development and updating of basic Power BI dashboards and management information products.
· Assist researchers and analysts in preparing datasets and outputs for further analysis.
3.6 Reporting and Documentation
· Prepare daily, weekly, and final field progress reports.
· Prepare data collection completion reports and field monitoring summaries.
· Document field challenges, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
· Support preparation of assessment, research, monitoring, and evaluation reports.
· Prepare tables, charts, and summary statistics for reports and presentations.
· Support interpretation of quantitative findings and synthesis of qualitative findings.
· Maintain complete documentation of field activities and research processes.
· Contribute to client reports, presentations, and other project deliverables.
3.7 Consultant and Field Personnel Management
· Coordinate consultants, enumerators, supervisors, facilitators, translators, and other short-term personnel.
· Maintain updated contact lists, attendance records, and assignment trackers.
· Coordinate staff availability, deployment, and deliverables.
· Follow up on agreed timelines and outputs.
· Support review of completed assignments and consultant deliverables.
· Coordinate communication between consultants, field teams, and project management.
· Support preparation of required administrative and operational documentation.
5. Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Public Administration, Monitoring and Evaluation, Research, or another relevant field.
A Master's degree will be considered an advantage.
Experience
The candidate should preferably have:
· 3–5 years of relevant experience in research, assessments, monitoring and evaluation, field coordination, or data collection.
· Demonstrated experience supervising enumerators and field data collection teams.
· Experience conducting or coordinating quantitative surveys.
· Practical experience with KIIs and FGDs.
· Experience conducting or coordinating phone-based surveys.
· Experience using SurveyCTO and/or KoboToolbox.
· Experience with data cleaning, data quality assurance, and data management.
· Experience using Microsoft Excel for data management and basic analysis.
· Experience preparing field, assessment, or research reports.
· Experience coordinating consultants, researchers, supervisors, or enumerators.
· Experience working on humanitarian, development, market research, or evaluation assignments is highly desirable.
6. Technical Skills
The successful candidate should demonstrate good working knowledge of:
· Quantitative and qualitative research methods
· Survey implementation and field coordination
· KIIs, FGDs, and phone-based surveys
· SurveyCTO and KoboToolbox
· Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word
· Data management and data cleaning
· Data quality assurance
· Basic statistical analysis
· Power BI and data visualization
· Research and field reporting
· Enumerator and consultant management
Strong Microsoft Excel skills are required, including experience with Pivot Tables, filtering, data validation, charts, lookup functions, IF formulas, COUNTIF/COUNTIFS, SUMIF/SUMIFS, and basic data analysis.
Knowledge of SPSS, Stata, R, Python, ODK, CommCare, or other research and analytical tools will be considered an advantage.

Job Requirements
7. Core Competencies
The candidate should demonstrate:
· Strong organizational and coordination skills.
· Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
· Good understanding of research and field data collection processes.
· Ability to supervise multiple field teams.

· Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple assignments.

· Willingness and ability to travel to provinces and field locations when required.
8. Language Requirements

· Good written and spoken English is required.
· Ability to review questionnaires, datasets, and reports in English is highly desirable.

title: Lecturer/Assistant Professor - PhD in Computer Science
description:
Role Summary
Are you a passionate, energetic and a result-oriented individual with strong communication skills and solid knowledge? If yes, this opportunity is for you. Kardan University is seeking experienced and motivated Lecturers/Assistant Professors to join our team of academicians and researchers.
Reporting to the Academic Administrator of the Department, the assistant professor/lecturer will be responsible for teaching and assessing students periodically through a set of evaluation mechanisms. He will also be responsible to review and revise the curriculum with the academic committee of the university.
We offer an exciting work environment conducive to academic and professional development of our Employees. Kardan University offers a competitive salary in the higher education industry.

Duties and Responsibilities
Duties & Responsibilities:
Facilitate student learning, provide effective instruction, and perform evaluations of student learning for all assigned classes
Build up professional logistics which helps in improvising the performances of the student.
Develop course handouts, lectures, labs, and presentations.
Participate in program level learning assessment
Participate in developing learning outcomes, choosing and administering measures, evaluating student performance, and suggesting changes to improve student learning.
Work with other faculty and administrators in developing program curriculum, standards, and policies, including reviewing and participating in textbook selection process where appropriate.
Guide, direct and mentor research scholars in their research projects.
Assess, supervise and mentor the academic progress in students.
Create, innovate and implement some activities and programs that help in career-enhancement.
Take part in all activities of the department, faculty and the University.
Support and serve up for various functional activities conducted by departmental committees.
Review, assess and evaluate the activities and progress of students.
Lend a hand, support and aid the Academic Administrator and Dean in their everyday functions and tasks.
Publish their research works or findings in academic books or journals.
Grade papers and tests; prepare exercises, lessons and lab experiments for the students.
Teach graduate as well as the undergraduate students within their field of expertise.
Submit the sessional and final results of the students within a week after midterm/ terminal examination.
Assist examination department and make presence in the examination hall during examinations and in the conduction of entry test.
Perform any other relevant task given by the management of Kardan University.

Job Requirements
PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Data Science , or a closely related field from a recognized university.
Minimum 03 years of teaching experience at a recognized higher education institution.
Strong academic and professional expertise in at least one of the following areas:
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Cybersecurity and Information Security
Data Science, Data Analytics, and Big Data
Demonstrated ability to teach undergraduate and graduate-level Computer Science courses within the candidate’s area of specialization.
Strong research background with evidence of research publications in recognized academic journals or other scholarly publications .
Ability to supervise and mentor students in research projects, dissertations, and other academic activities.
Demonstrated knowledge of current technologies, methodologies, and developments relevant to the candidate’s area of specialization.
Practical experience with relevant programming languages, software, frameworks, platforms, or analytical tools will be an advantage.
Strong organizational, interpersonal, academic, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to teach effectively in English and command of at least one national language.
At least 80% Master's degree marks or a B grade in the case of a foreign degree.
At least 75% Bachelor's degree marks or a B grade in the case of a foreign degree.
The Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degrees must demonstrate above 60% field consistency (Degree Relevance) .
The degree must be attested by the Ministry of Higher Education of Afghanistan in the case of a foreign degree.

Submission Guidelines
Qualified candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/resume and cover letter combined into a single PDF document to jobs@kardan.edu.af .
Applicants are required to include the Vacancy Reference Number provided in the vacancy announcement in the subject line of their email .
Example:
HRM/KU/003
Applications that do not include the correct Vacancy Reference Number in the email subject line may not be considered for shortlisting .
The Vacancy Reference Number must be used exactly as stated in the respective vacancy announcement to ensure accurate identification and processing of applications.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to participate in the interview/demonstration , as applicable to the position.
We appreciate the interest of all applicants. Only candidates selected for the next stage of the recruitment process will be contacted.

The General Scientific and Strategic Board is BARM's senior scientific and advisory body. Members review major studies, proposals, policy documents and urgent issues, provide expert advice and support quality improvement. The Board provides technical recommendations; final institutional and publication approval rests with the Head of Office.
A. Core Responsibilities
• Advise on BARM's research priorities, annual agenda and major topics.
• Review research proposals, methodologies, policy documents, plans and reports.
• Provide a clear written recommendation for approval, conditional approval, revision, re-review or rejection.
• Monitor major developments and turn research findings into practical recommendations and solutions.
B. Oversight Responsibilities
• Review the quality of research questions, methods, sources, data, analysis, findings and recommendations.
• Ensure compliance with research ethics, confidentiality, academic integrity and conflict-of-interest rules.
• Follow up agreed corrections and assigned actions during Board meetings.
C. Coordination Responsibilities
• Work with the Research Manager, research teams and other Board specialists.
• Support scientific links with universities, government institutions and experts, and contribute to technical discussions.

• Experience in multidisciplinary teamwork, scientific boards or technical review is an advantage.
Skills and Abilities

• Strong analysis, academic reasoning, report writing and practical problem-solving skills.
• Teamwork, professional communication, presentation and management of differing views.
• Ability to use Microsoft Office, academic databases and relevant analytical tools.
• Fluency in Pashto or Dari, working ability in the other national language, and sufficient English for international sources.

Working Conditions

• Members will receive an attendance allowance in accordance with Barm's financial and administrative policies.
• Active participation, timely written reviews and completion of assigned work.

• Repeated absence, failure to perform duties or breach of confidentiality may lead to review of membership.

• Links to research articles published in recognized international journals, clearly indicating the applicant’s authorship or contribution.
• One non-confidential academic sample and contact details for two professional references
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Barm may verify qualifications, experience, authorship, publications and professional references. Recruitment is merit-based, and the selected candidate must comply with Barm policies on ethics, confidentiality, data protection, conflicts of interest and professional conduct.

Duties and Responsibilities
· تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربع‌وار و سالانه مربوط به فعالیت‌های توسعه ذخایر نفت و گاز و تنظیم آن مطابق اولویت‌ها و اهداف تعیین‌شدۀ شرکت.
· نظارت، کنترول و تنظیم مؤثر سنسورها، سیستم‌های کنترول و تجهیزات اتوماتیک ذخایر مواد نفتی و گاز مایع و اطمینان از عملکرد مطلوب و مستمر آن‌ها.
· توسعه و مدیریت بر فعالیت‌های اتاق کنترول دیجیتال (Digital Control Room) و سیستم‌های کنترول مرتبط، به‌منظور تأمین نظارت مستمر و کنترول مؤثر وضعیت ذخایر.
· نظارت و کنترول پارامترهای اساسی ذخایر، شامل سطح، فشار، حرارت، جریان و سایر شاخص‌های تخنیکی، و اطمینان از ثبت و گزارش‌دهی منظم اطلاعات مربوطه.
· نظارت بر عملکرد سیستم‌های کنترول اتوماتیک، سیستم‌های آلارم، هشداردهنده‌ها و تجهیزات مرتبط با ایمنی و مصونیت ذخایر و اتخاذ اقدامات لازم در حالات غیرعادی.

· ترتیب جداول آماری و مقایسوی از وضعیت ذخایر به تفکیک محل، نوع مواد، ظرفیت و دورۀ زمانی.
· همکاری در ارزیابی اقتصادی و تخنیکی گزینه‌های توسعه ذخایر و مقایسۀ سناریوهای مختلف از لحاظ ظرفیت ذخایر، هزینه، منفعت و امکان‌پذیری اجرایی.
· پیگیری تطبیق برنامه‌ها و پروژه‌های مرتبط با توسعه ذخایر و مقایسۀ پیشرفت فعالیت‌ها با پلان‌های تأییدشده و ارائه گزارش از انحرافات و چالش‌های موجود.
· شناسایی مشکلات و محدودیت‌های تخنیکی، عملیاتی و معلوماتی مؤثر بر توسعه ذخایر و هماهنگی با بخش‌های مربوط برای دریافت راه‌حل‌های مناسب.
· تنظیم و به‌روزرسانی بانک معلومات و اسناد مربوط به ذخایر، مطالعات، طرح‌های توسعه‌یی و نتایج فعالیت‌های انجام‌شده، مطابق سیستم ثبت و نگهداری معلومات شرکت.
· تهیه گزارش‌های تحلیلی، تخنیکی و معلوماتی دوره‌یی در مورد وضعیت ذخایر، ظرفیت توسعه، پیشرفت برنامه‌ها، فرصت‌ها، چالش‌ها و نتایج فعالیت‌های انجام‌شده و ارائه آن به بخش مربوط.
· اشتراک فعال در بازدیدهای ذخایر و بررسی وضعیت موجودی، ظرفیت، تجهیزات و فعالیت‌های عملیاتی در صورت هدایت بخش مربوطه.
· انجام سایر وظایف مسلکی مرتبط به توسعه ذخایر نفت و گاز که مطابق قوانین، مقررات، پالیسی‌ها، طرزالعمل‌ها و هدایات مقامات ذی‌صلاح به وی سپرده می‌شود.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to join our development team and contribute to the enhancement of our cutting-edge FinTech solutions. You will be responsible for designing and building scalable backend systems using Java and Spring Boot , creating dynamic user interfaces with Angular , and ensuring seamless integrations with third-party services and payment switches. Your role will support the full lifecycle of our AurumPay Mobile Money system, from design to deployment, working within an agile development culture.

Duties and Responsibilities
1. Software Development & Quality Control
Participate in the complete software development process for FinTech projects, including mobile apps, websites, and digital wallets.
Design and develop scalable frontend and backend components for enterprise-grade applications, meeting high standards for security, performance, and compliance.
Write efficient, maintainable code, and contribute to the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Design and optimize databases (e.g., Oracle) to support applications and ensure data integrity.
2. Backend & API Development
Develop backend services using Java and the Spring Boot ecosystem.
Design, build, and manage RESTful APIs for both internal and external use.
Assist in managing integrations with third-party services, including mobile operators, digital wallets, Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), payment switches, and gateways.
3. Frontend Development

Collaborate with team members to translate business requirements into intuitive UI/UX designs.
4. System Design & Infrastructure
Contribute to technical system architectures and integration plans based on business needs.
Ensure all systems connect properly with payment switches and gateways.
Assist in system and database performance tuning and scalability.

Participate in code reviews and share knowledge with team members.

Job Requirements
Experience: Minimum of 3 years of proven experience as a Full Stack Developer, with a focus on enterprise-grade applications, ideally in the FinTech sector.
Backend Expertise: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Java and the Spring Boot framework.
Frontend Expertise: Proven experience developing modern user interfaces with Angular .
API Development: Experience in designing and building RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party services.
Database Skills: Proficiency in working with relational databases, including complex SQL queries, performance tuning, and schema design. Experience with Oracle is a strong plus.
Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with microservices architecture, the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), and version control tools like GitHub/GitLab.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Experience deploying applications on Oracle WebLogic Server.
Familiarity with mobile app development using Flutter.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes.
Knowledge of financial industry protocols like ISO 8583.

title: Network Officer
description:
Role Summary
The Network Officer is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting the Bank network infrastructure under the supervision of the Network Administrator / IT Manager.
The position will assist in maintaining the availability, reliability, performance, and security of network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, IP telephony, network links, and related communication infrastructure.
The Network Officer will also provide technical support to branch IT personnel, assist with network-related projects and implementations, maintain network documentation, perform configuration backup and restoration, and support the Network Administrator in ensuring stable and secure network services for the Bank business operations.

Duties and Responsibilities
Assist the Network Administrator in the operation, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of the Bank’s network infrastructure.
Monitor network devices, links, and services to identify connectivity, performance, availability, and security-related issues.
Assist in the installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of network devices, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPN devices, and related infrastructure.
Assist the Network Administrator in troubleshooting and maintaining Cisco networking equipment and Sophos firewall infrastructure.
Provide remote and on-site technical support to branch IT personnel for network connectivity and infrastructure-related issues.
Assist in the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Cisco IP phones and related IP telephony infrastructure.
Perform and maintain configuration backups and restoration of network devices in accordance with approved procedures.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date network diagrams, device inventories, IP addressing records, configuration records, and technical documentation.
Prepare and maintain network device configuration notes, implementation records, and other relevant technical documentation.
Assist in the installation, labeling, organization, and maintenance of network cables, patch panels, racks, and related network infrastructure.
Conduct network site surveys for new branches, offices, and other locations and assist in preparing the required network equipment, materials, and technical requirements.
Assist the Network Administrator in analyzing network traffic, performance, and utilization to ensure optimal network availability and performance.
Assist in monitoring and maintaining network security controls to support secure and reliable network operations in accordance with the Bank’s approved IT and information security policies.
Assist in identifying network capacity requirements and support capacity planning based on business and operational requirements.
Assist with the implementation and testing of approved network changes, upgrades, configurations, and infrastructure projects in accordance with the Bank’s change management procedures.
Escalate major network incidents, security concerns, service interruptions, and other critical issues to the Network Administrator / concerned line manager in a timely manner.
Maintain proper records of network incidents, troubleshooting activities, changes, and resolutions for future reference and audit requirements.
Support the Network Administrator in ensuring network availability and business continuity, including support for network-related activities associated with the Bank’ disaster recovery environment.
Coordinate with relevant IT teams, service providers, and vendors, when required, for the resolution of network-related technical issues.
Perform any other network-related duties and responsibilities assigned by the line manager in accordance with the Bank requirements and applicable policies and procedures.

Job Requirements
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certification such as CCNA and CCNP is required or equivalent certification is an advantage.
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in network infrastructure, preferably within a banking, financial, or other enterprise environment.
Practical hands-on experience with Cisco networking devices, including switches, routers and firewalls.
Good working knowledge of firewall, Site to Site VPN IPsec, routing, switching, VLAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and network troubleshooting concepts.
Practical knowledge of Firewall and Cisco security/networking technologies is preferred.
Knowledge and practical experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools is an advantage.
Familiarity with network security principles, access control, segmentation, and secure network operations.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve day-to-day network connectivity and infrastructure issues effectively.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and respond to critical network incidents when required.
Strong interpersonal, communication, coordination, and teamwork skills.
Ability to prepare and maintain accurate technical documentation.
Willingness and ability to work outside normal working hours when required for critical incidents, maintenance, upgrades, or business continuity activities.

Submission Guidelines
Qualified and interested applicants are encouraged to apply online through the BMA Job Portal at https://jobs.bma.com.af before the closing date.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
Email / Application Form: https://jobs.bma.com.af

title: IT Security Analyst
description:
Role Summary
The IT Security Analyst is responsible for protecting the Bank’s information assets, systems, and infrastructure by implementing, monitoring, and enhancing information security controls. The role ensures that cybersecurity risks are effectively identified, managed, and escalated in line with Basel principles, regulatory requirements, and the Bank’s risk appetite .
The position supports operational IT security under the Dy-CIO while ensuring indepndent risk oversight and incident escalation to the CRO

Duties and Responsibilities
A. Information Security Operations
Monitor IT systems, networks, and applications for security threats and vulnerabilities.
Implement and maintain security controls, tools, and configurations.
Support secure system configurations across CBS, applications, servers, and networks.
Ensure compliance with approved IT security standards and policies.
B. Cyber Risk & Incident Management
Detect, analyze, and respond to information security incidents and cyber threats.
Escalate material security incidents, cyber risks, and control weaknesses to the CRO in a timely manner.
Support incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and remediation actions.
Maintain incident logs and prepare incident reports.
C. Governance, Risk & Compliance Support
Support the implementation of the Bank’s Information Security Policy , IT governance framework, and risk controls.
Coordinate with Risk Management to:
Identify IT and cyber risks
Support risk assessments and KRIs
Align controls with the Bank’s risk appetite
Support Compliance requirements related to data protection, access controls, and regulatory expectations.
D. Access Control & Security Monitoring
Monitor and review user access rights to critical systems (including CBS).
Support periodic access reviews and segregation of duties controls.
Ensure timely removal or modification of access for staff movements and terminations.
E. Vulnerability Management & Security Testing
Conduct or coordinate vulnerability assessments and security testing.
Track remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
Support implementation of security patches and system hardening.
F. Audit & Regulatory Support
Act as a focal point for IT security matters during:
Internal Audit
External Audit
Regulatory examinations
Support closure of IT security-related audit findings and regulatory observations.
G. Awareness & Capacity Building
Support IT security awareness initiatives and training programs for staff.
Promote a strong security culture and compliance with security policies.
7. Authority & Escalation
Recommend security improvements and corrective actions.
Escalate high-risk security incidents and systemic weaknesses to Dy-CIO and CRO.
No authority to override business or system decisions without approval.

Job Requirements
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Professional Certifications (Preferred)
CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, ISO 27001, or equivalent information security certifications.
Experience
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in IT security, cybersecurity, or information risk management.
Experience in banking, financial services, or regulated environments is a strong advantage.

Submission Guidelines
Applicants who meet the above requirements are invited to submit their updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) or Resume to sr.recruitment-officer@ghazanfarbank.com .
Please ensure that you include the position title and vacancy announcement number in the email subject line ( IT Security Analyst GB/EAD/62 ).
Applications that do not follow this format will not be considered.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Role Summary
The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and supporting MOAM’s web, backend, and mobile applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience with .NET Core backend development and microservice architecture, Next.js frontend development, Flutter mobile development, and the infrastructure required to run these systems reliably in production.
The position will contribute to the design, development, and evolution of MOAM’s digital logistics ecosystem, including Courier and Cargo products across web and mobile platforms, shared backend services, system integrations, and future digital solutions, with responsibility spanning APIs, distributed services, caching, messaging, observability, databases, containerization, server administration, security, performance, and third-party integrations. The developer is expected to work across the complete software delivery lifecycle and collaborate closely with the Technology Unit and business stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities
A. Backend Development & Microservices
· Design, develop, maintain, and optimize backend services and REST APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core / .NET Core.
· Design services using microservice architecture, clear service boundaries, maintainable domain/application layers, and clean architecture principles.
· Implement authentication, authorization, role/permission management, API validation, error handling, background processing, and secure service-to-service communication.
· Work with SQL Server and relational data access using Entity Framework Core; design efficient schemas, migrations, indexes, transactions, and queries.
· Implement distributed caching and cache invalidation strategies using Redis or equivalent technologies.
· Use RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, queues, retries, and reliable communication between services; implement real-time application features using appropriate technologies such as SignalR/WebSockets where required.
· Integrate MOAM systems with ERP (including Sage), CRM, payment gateways, SMS/notification services, Firebase, customs systems, and other internal or third-party platforms.
B. Frontend Development
· Develop and maintain responsive, secure, production-ready web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
· Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, authentication flows, real-time features, and server-side/client-side data fetching as appropriate.
· Build reusable UI components, handle application state effectively, and ensure performance, accessibility, maintainability, and cross-browser compatibility.
C. Mobile Application Development
· Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
· Integrate Flutter applications with .NET APIs and Firebase services such as Cloud Messaging/push notifications, authentication, analytics, or other required Firebase capabilities.
· Manage mobile application state, API communication, error handling, local persistence, release builds, and application performance.
D. DevOps, Server & Deployment Management
· Containerize applications and supporting services using Docker and Docker Compose; maintain reliable environment configuration across development, staging, and production.
· Administer and troubleshoot application servers, preferably Linux-based environments, including services, networking, ports, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxies such as Nginx, storage, permissions, and resource usage.
· Support CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, environment variables/secrets, deployment automation, backups, rollback procedures, and production releases.
· Monitor application and infrastructure health and diagnose production issues across services, containers, databases, logs, queues, caches, and network dependencies.
E. Logging, Monitoring & Reliability
· Implement structured application logging using Serilog and centralized log monitoring/analysis using Seq.
· Design meaningful logs, correlation identifiers, health checks, metrics, alerts, and diagnostics to support distributed systems and production troubleshooting.
· Improve application performance, scalability, resilience, fault handling, and availability through profiling, testing, and operational monitoring.
F. Quality, Security & Engineering Practices
· Write unit and integration tests and perform API, frontend, and mobile validation before release.
· Apply secure coding practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection, input validation, dependency management, and API security.
· Participate in technical design, sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, Git workflows, troubleshooting, and documentation.
· Produce clear technical documentation for architecture, APIs, deployments, integrations, and operational procedures.

Job Requirements
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
· Strong professional experience building full-stack production applications, with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core as the primary backend technology.
· Hands-on experience with microservices, REST APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, Redis caching, RabbitMQ messaging, Serilog, and Seq.
· Hands-on experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
· Hands-on experience developing mobile applications with Flutter/Dart and integrating Firebase services.
· Practical experience with Docker/containerization, Git, server administration, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.
· Good understanding of software architecture, security, performance, scalability, concurrency, testing, and distributed-system fundamentals.
· Ability to independently analyze technical problems, communicate clearly, document solutions, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
· Good command of English for technical documentation and communication; Dari and/or Pashto are advantageous.
Preferred / Advantageous Experience
· API gateways/reverse proxies (for example YARP or Nginx), CQRS/Mediator patterns, background workers, scheduled jobs, and distributed tracing.
· CI/CD platforms, cloud or VPS environments, DNS/SSL management, backups, monitoring, and production incident response.
· Experience integrating ERP/CRM, logistics, warehouse, cargo, payment, notification, or other enterprise systems.
· Experience with Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, automated testing, code quality tools, and Agile/Scrum delivery.

Submission Guidelines

All documents should be submitted in PDF format , with the file name clearly indicating your first and last name and the position applied for . Please note that interviews may be conducted while the position remains open and under announcement .
